requirement.evidence: No person shall engage in the business of finding dwelling accommodations for prospective tenants for a fee unless such person is a licensed broker or salesman as defined in section eighty-seven PP of chapter one hundred and twelve.
requirement.note: The statute bars unlicensed persons from engaging in the business of finding housing for a fee. The card's added instruction not to pay a finder's fee to an unlicensed person is a plain-language gloss not stated in the text.

requirement.evidence: Any fee shall only be paid by the party, lessor or tenant who originally engaged and entered into a contract with the licensed broker or salesperson.
requirement.note: The statement that a tenant cannot be made to pay a fee when the landlord hired the broker follows directly from this text.
